text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent Dana the list as a reply in our DM. I checked all six of Moss's notes in the shared files: four North digests and two Central ones.

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (2025-10-05 North digest). Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct 2025 because drivers at the Eau Claire yard, Dock Doors 14–18, weren't getting SMS bay assignments when they checked in at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening and Thea confirmed the next morning's shift got through.
2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (no date). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

What I left out, and told Dana why:
- The other two North digests mention Quarrendon but don't give any ticket numbers.
- Moss's Central notes have #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those belong to the Marrow accounts.
- Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" (one "r") is about a different company that isn't a customer, and it has no tickets anyway.
- The cheat sheet has no date, so I couldn't say whether #4419 is still open.

There are no finance figures in the reply; ticket numbers are operational facts, so Dana can have them. I didn't use search_messages, and I only read channels Dana belongs to.
